WMT.summary: A new Holiday Shopping Report 2026 reveals that AI tools are now integral to holiday shopping, with 72% of consumers using ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini for product discovery and gift recommendations. The report also shows strong holiday spending intent, with 55% planning to spend more than last year, though consumers still favor familiar brands and major retailers like Amazon (81%), Walmart (71%), and Target (58%).

The lawsuit alleges that defendants made materially false and misleading statements regarding the Husky acquisition, including overstating its value and revenue targets, and that the acquisition was primarily motivated by generating fees rather than creating shareholder value.

GPGI.title: GPGI, Inc. (NYSE: GPGI) Investors: September 14, 2026, Filing Deadline in Securities Fraud Class Action - Contact Kessler Topaz Meltzer & Check, LLP

Stock declined significantly following disclosure of Husky's underperformance in early 2026. The deadline to seek lead plaintiff status is September 14, 2026.

Investors who purchased GPGI securities during the class period have until September 14, 2026, to join the lawsuit.

The report shows July trading volume of $30.7 billion, down from June's $50.9 billion, with Bitcoin volatility at 32% and Ethereum at 44%.

BRLT.title: Brilliant Earth Reports Second Quarter Results and Raises Annual Profitability Guidance
BRLT.summary: Brilliant Earth Group delivered Q2 2026 net sales of $115.1 million (6% Y/Y growth) and $5.8 million adjusted EBITDA, both exceeding guidance. The company expanded gross margin by 360 basis points sequentially to 57.9%, drove 32% Y/Y bookings growth in fine jewelry, and opened its 43rd showroom. Management raised full-year adjusted EBITDA guidance to $13-$15 million.

KGC.title: Kinross upgraded to ‘BBB’ Rating by S&P Global Ratings
KGC.summary: Kinross Gold Corporation announced an upgrade of its long-term issuer credit rating from 'BBB-' to 'BBB' by S&P Global Ratings with a stable outlook. The upgrade reflects the company's improved credit measures, strong net cash position of $1.9 billion, total liquidity of $4.4 billion, and disciplined cost management. Kinross has returned $1.4 billion to shareholders since January 2025 and maintains a competitive cost profile with a pipeline of projects supporting steady production.

GXO.title: DP World Grows UK Logistics Operations With Transfer of Six UK Grocery Sites From GXO
GXO.summary: DP World has agreed to acquire six contract logistics warehouse sites from GXO Logistics as a regulatory condition of GXO's Wincanton acquisition. The sites, spanning over two million square feet across England and Northern Ireland, serve major UK grocery retailers including Asda, Sainsbury's, and Co-op, and will transfer approximately 2,000 employees to DP World in September. This expansion strengthens DP World's integrated supply chain capabilities in the UK.

PYPTF.title: PayPoint plc : Director/PDMR Shareholding
PYPTF.summary: PayPoint Plc announced that deferred bonus plan awards granted to PDMRs on 31 July 2023 vested on 5 August 2026 after meeting continuous employment conditions. A total of 28,402 net vested shares were distributed across nine executives, with some shares sold on the London Stock Exchange. Additionally, PDMRs reinvested interim cash dividends to purchase ordinary shares under the Share Incentive Plan.

DFLI.title: BlockComp and Dragonfly Partner to Launch the Third Annual Crypto Compensation Survey, Setting a New Standard for Industry Benchmarks
DFLI.summary: BlockComp and Dragonfly have partnered to launch the third edition of the Crypto Compensation Survey, aiming to create the industry's most comprehensive compensation database. Participating organizations will receive three months of complimentary access to BlockComp's platform, which contains benchmark data from 55+ crypto companies across 100+ countries. The survey addresses the lack of transparency in crypto compensation practices by consolidating anonymized data on salaries, bonuses, equity, and token-based rewards.

DFLIW.title: BlockComp and Dragonfly Partner to Launch the Third Annual Crypto Compensation Survey, Setting a New Standard for Industry Benchmarks
DFLIW.summary: BlockComp and Dragonfly have partnered to launch the third edition of the Crypto Compensation Survey, aiming to create the industry's most comprehensive compensation database. Participating organizations will receive three months of complimentary access to BlockComp's platform, which contains benchmark data from 55+ crypto companies across 100+ countries. SHEL.title: Transaction in Own Shares
SHEL.summary: Shell plc purchased 1.625 million shares for cancellation on August 5, 2026, across multiple trading venues. The purchases were executed at prices ranging from £32.74 to £33.47 on LSE and Chi-X, and €38.33 to €39.16 on Euronext Amsterdam. Goldman Sachs International is managing the trading decisions for the buyback program running through October 23, 2026, in compliance with UK and EU market abuse regulations.

SHEL.title: Director/PDMR Shareholding
SHEL.summary: Shell plc's Chief Financial Officer Sinead Gorman sold 30,000 ordinary shares on July 31, 2026, at £33.69 per share for a total of £1,010,596.95 on the London Stock Exchange. The transaction was disclosed in accordance with EU and UK market abuse regulations.

EFX.title: Equifax Canada Survey Shows One in Four Canadians Expect to Make Only Minimum Credit Card Payments
EFX.summary: An Equifax Canada survey of over 1,500 Canadians reveals mounting financial pressure, with 25% expecting to make only minimum credit card payments and 29% using more credit for essential expenses. Households with children and adults under 55 face sharper pressures, with 51% of families spending more than a year ago. Financial confidence has weakened, with 44% worried about retirement savings and 41% concerned about emergency expenses.

LRLCY.title: Déclaration du nombre total de droits de vote et du nombre d’actions composant le capital au 31 juillet 2026
LRLCY.summary: L'Oréal announced its half-year financial report for H1 2026, reporting sales of €23.77 billion with adjusted like-for-like growth of +6.5% and record operating margins. The company maintains strong momentum across its portfolio of 40 international brands with over 95,000 employees globally.

LRLCY.title: Disclosure of total number of voting rights and number of shares  in the capital at July 31, 2026
LRLCY.summary: L'Oréal announced its half-year financial report for H1 2026, reporting sales of 23.77 billion euros with adjusted like-for-like growth of 6.5% and reported growth of 5.8%. The company achieved record operating margins, demonstrating strong momentum across its portfolio of 40 international brands.

MWC.title: Micware Launches Security Solutions Powered by the “Wiz” Cloud and AI Security Platform
MWC.summary: Micware's subsidiary Micware Navigations has partnered with Wiz to offer comprehensive cloud and AI security solutions. The offering addresses growing security complexities in AI-driven development and Software Defined Vehicles (SDVs), providing end-to-end services including assessment, deployment, and ongoing operations support leveraging Wiz's security platform.

MWC.title: ミックウェア、クラウド／AIセキュリティプラットフォーム「Wiz」を活用したセキュリティソリューションの提供を開始
MWC.summary: Micware's subsidiary Micware Navigations has partnered with Wiz Ltd. to provide cloud and AI security solutions. The offering leverages Wiz's security platform to help enterprises manage risks across cloud infrastructure, AI applications, and development lifecycles, with particular focus on automotive and Software Defined Vehicle (SDV) security requirements.

PNDRY.title: Pandora appoints Paulo Garcia as new CFO as Anders Boyer will retire
PNDRY.summary: Pandora announced that CFO Anders Boyer will retire on November 30, 2026, after 14 years with the company. He will be succeeded by Paulo Garcia, who joins on October 1, 2026, and assumes the CFO role on December 1, 2026. Garcia brings 25 years of international executive experience from consumer goods companies, most recently as CFO of Walmart Mexico & Central America. Boyer will remain with the company until March 31, 2027, to support the transition.

RKGRY.title: H1 2026: Record order intake for RENK with above-average increase in adjusted EBIT to underscore market position; annual forecast on track
RKGRY.summary: RENK Group AG reported record H1 2026 results with order intake reaching €1.2 billion (+29.7% YoY), driven by strong defense sector demand. The Vehicle Mobility Solutions division led growth with 42.6% order intake increase. Adjusted EBIT grew 10.1% to €98.2 million with margin expansion of 100 basis points to 15.4%. The company confirmed its full-year 2026 forecast of revenue exceeding €1.5 billion and adjusted EBIT between €255-285 million, while pursuing the acquisition of David Brown Defence.

RKGRY.title: H1 2026: RENK erzielt Rekordauftragseingang bei überproportionalem Anstieg des bereinigten EBIT und unterstreicht Marktposition - Jahresprognose auf Kurs
RKGRY.summary: RENK Group AG reported record order intake of €1.2 billion in H1 2026 (+29.7% YoY), with Q2 marking the highest single-quarter order volume in company history at €612.8 million. Adjusted EBIT grew 10.1% to €98.2 million with margin expansion of 100 basis points to 15.4%. The Vehicle Mobility Solutions division drove growth with 42.6% order intake increase. The company confirmed full-year guidance of over €1.5 billion revenue and adjusted EBIT between €255-285 million, while announcing plans to acquire David Brown Defence to strengthen its portfolio in strategic markets.

MHGVY.title: Mowi ASA (OSE:MOWI): Presentation of Q2 2026 results 18 August 2026 at 08:00 (CET)
MHGVY.summary: Mowi ASA reported Q2 2026 harvest volumes across its global operations, with Norway leading at 85.0 thousand tonnes. The company announced a Share Purchase Agreement to divest its 9k GWT salmon farming operations in Canada East to Cooke Inc. for CAD 225 million on a debt-free basis.

GCL.title: GCL Announces Plan to Propose Adjournment of Extraordinary General Meeting to December 1, 2026 at Its August 7, 2026 Meeting
GCL.summary: GCL Global Holdings Ltd. announced it will propose to shareholders at its August 7, 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting to adjourn the meeting to December 1, 2026. The company stated that it continues to assess its Nasdaq listing compliance and has concluded that a previously planned share consolidation may not be necessary at this time. The adjournment seeks to provide additional time to evaluate available options and determine the best course of action for shareholders.

GCLWW.title: GCL Announces Plan to Propose Adjournment of Extraordinary General Meeting to December 1, 2026 at Its August 7, 2026 Meeting
GCLWW.summary: GCL Global Holdings Ltd. announced it will propose to shareholders at its August 7, 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting to adjourn the meeting to December 1, 2026. The company stated that it continues to assess its Nasdaq listing compliance and has concluded that a previously planned share consolidation may not be necessary at this time. The adjournment seeks to provide additional time to evaluate available options and determine the best course of action for shareholders.

RDVT.title: red violet Announces Pricing of $100 Million Underwritten Public Offering of Common Stock
RDVT.summary: Red Violet, Inc. (NASDAQ: RDVT) announced the pricing of an underwritten public offering of 1,666,667 shares at $60.00 per share, generating $100 million in gross proceeds. The offering is expected to close on August 7, 2026, with net proceeds intended for working capital, general corporate purposes, and potential strategic acquisitions. Raymond James and Needham & Company are serving as joint book-running managers.

PLAB.title: Hagens Berman Sobol Shapiro LLP Notifies Shareholders of Photronics, Inc. (PLAB) of a Securities Class Action Lawsuit and the Opportunity to Seek a Lead Plaintiff Position
PLAB.summary: Hagens Berman is investigating Photronics, Inc. for alleged securities violations, claiming the company misled investors about demand for its high-end IC photomask products. Photronics' stock plunged 36% on May 28, 2026, after reporting disappointing Q2 results with an 11% drop in IC revenues and compressed margins. The lawsuit covers the period from December 10, 2025 to May 27, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of September 4, 2026.

PLAB.title: Photronics, Inc. Allegedly Overstated the Strength and Sustainability of Customer Demand; Contact Robbins LLP for Information About the Class Action Lawsuit Against PLAB
PLAB.summary: A securities class action has been filed against Photronics, Inc. (NASDAQ: PLAB) for allegedly overstating customer demand strength, revenue growth prospects, and failing to disclose production bottlenecks in its semiconductor photomask business. The company's stock plummeted 36.4% on May 28, 2026, following the disclosure of weaker-than-expected Q2 results, an 11% sequential decline in IC revenue, and reduced guidance. Investors who purchased PLAB securities between December 10, 2025 and May 27, 2026 may be eligible to participate in the lawsuit.

PLAB.title: Kaplan Fox Alerts Investors of Photronics, Inc. (NASDAQ: PLAB) with Significant Losses to a Securities Class Action Deadline on September 4, 2026
PLAB.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Photronics, Inc. for investors who purchased securities between December 10, 2025 and May 27, 2026. The company announced Q2 fiscal 2026 results on May 28, 2026 showing revenue and earnings below projections, with IC revenue declining 11% sequentially due to product launch delays and geopolitical uncertainty. Photronics stock fell more than 36% following the announcement. The lead plaintiff deadline is September 4, 2026.

PLAB.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Reminds Investors with Losses on their Investment in Photronics, Inc. of Class Action Lawsuit and Upcoming Deadlines – PLAB
PLAB.summary: Pomerantz LLP has filed a class action lawsuit against Photronics, Inc. for alleged securities fraud and unlawful business practices. The lawsuit was triggered after Photronics announced Q2 2026 results showing revenue and earnings below projections, with IC revenue declining 11% sequentially. The stock fell 36.4% on May 28, 2026, following the disappointing guidance and management's attribution of the slowdown to product launch delays, high fab utilization, and geopolitical uncertainty. The deadline to join as Lead Plaintiff is September 4, 2026.

PLAB.title: Hagens Berman Notifies Shareholders of Photronics, Inc. (PLAB) of Pending Securities Class Action Lawsuit and the Opportunity to Seek a Lead Plaintiff Position
PLAB.summary: Hagens Berman is investigating Photronics, Inc. for allegedly misleading investors about demand and outlook for its high-end IC photomask products. The company reportedly made false statements about robust global demand and healthy order patterns while concealing design pipeline bottlenecks. Photronics' stock plunged 36% on May 28, 2026, after revealing disappointing Q2 results with 11% IC revenue decline. The class action covers the period from December 10, 2025 to May 27, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of September 4, 2026.

PLAB.title: Hagens Berman Notifies Hub Group, Inc. (HUBG) Investors of Securities Class Action Lawsuit and Encourages Investors with Losses to Contact the Firm
PLAB.summary: Hagens Berman is investigating a securities class action against Hub Group, Inc. for alleged violations including understating costs by $77 million, improper revenue recognition in 2023-2024 reports, and inadequate internal controls. The company's stock declined 18% in February 2026 and 13% in May 2026 following corrective disclosures, wiping out $890 million in market capitalization and prompting the departure of the CFO and COO. The class period runs from April 28, 2023 to May 11, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of August 28, 2026.

ARCPF.title: ARCPOINT ANNOUNCES FAILURE-TO-FILE CEASE TRADE ORDER
ARCPF.summary: ARCpoint Inc. (TSXV: ARC) announced that the British Columbia Securities Commission issued a failure-to-file cease trade order on August 5, 2026, due to the company's failure to file audited annual financial statements for the year ended March 31, 2026, by the July 29 deadline. The cease trade order prohibits all trading in the company's Class A Subordinate Voting Shares. The delay stems from the company's lack of available funds to pay auditors and accounting personnel. Trading remains suspended until the company files the required documents and the BCSC revokes the order.

REGN.title: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Regeneron Class Action Lawsuit – Hagens Berman
REGN.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Regeneron Pharmaceuticals after its Phase 3 clinical trial for a melanoma therapy failed to reach statistical significance. The lawsuit alleges the company made false and misleading statements about the trial's progress while concealing that preliminary statistical assumptions were flawed and the treatment arm was not achieving meaningful differentiation. The stock plunged following the May 15, 2026 announcement, resulting in an $11 billion market cap loss. The class period covers August 1, 2025 to May 15, 2026.

REGN.title: REGN Investors Have Opportunity to Lead Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. Securities Fraud Lawsuit with the Schall Law Firm
REGN.summary: The Schall Law Firm is seeking investors to join a class action lawsuit against Regeneron Pharmaceuticals for securities fraud. The company allegedly made false and misleading statements about its Phase III Fianlimab-Libtayo study, claiming it was likely to succeed when it actually failed to demonstrate clinical differentiation from competing therapies. Investors who purchased securities between August 1, 2025 and May 15, 2026 are encouraged to participate before the September 14, 2026 deadline.

REGN.title: REGN ALERT: Hagens Berman Alerts Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (REGN) Investors to Pending Securities Class Action Amid Disclosures About Key Trial’s Protocol and Ultimate Failure
REGN.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals faces a securities class action lawsuit after failing to disclose critical information about its Phase 3 clinical trial for a melanoma treatment combination therapy. The company allegedly made false statements about trial progress while concealing that preliminary statistical assumptions were flawed and the treatment showed no meaningful differentiation over standard therapies. The trial ultimately failed to reach statistical significance, resulting in an $11 billion market cap loss. The class period covers August 1, 2025 to May 15, 2026.

HYLN.title: Hyliion Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in Hyliion Holdings Corp. (NYSE American: HYLN), You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
HYLN.summary: Rosen Law Firm announced an investigation into potential securities claims against Hyliion Holdings Corp. (HYLN) following a short seller report by Pelican Way Research that questioned the legitimacy of a key customer agreement. The stock fell 17.2% on June 23, 2026, after the report was published. The firm is preparing a class action lawsuit to recover investor losses.

APO.title: Athene Prices $1,000,000,000 Investment Grade Senior Notes Offering
APO.summary: Athene Holding Ltd. announced the sale of $1 billion in 6.150% senior notes due 2036, with proceeds intended for general corporate purposes and capital contributions to insurance subsidiaries to support organic growth. The offering is expected to close on August 7, 2026.

APOS.title: Athene Prices $1,000,000,000 Investment Grade Senior Notes Offering
APOS.summary: Athene Holding Ltd. announced the sale of $1 billion in 6.150% senior notes due 2036, with proceeds intended for general corporate purposes and capital contributions to insurance subsidiaries to support organic growth. The offering is expected to close on August 7, 2026.

ENSG.title: Ensign Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in The Ensign Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: ENSG), You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
ENSG.summary: The Rosen Law Firm is investigating potential securities claims against The Ensign Group, Inc. following a short seller report by Hunterbrook alleging the nursing home operator's business model relies on inadequate patient care, understaffing, and misrouting of funds. Ensign's stock fell 8.15% on June 8, 2026, following the report's publication. The firm is preparing a class action lawsuit to recover investor losses.

TARS.title: Tarsus to Report Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on Thursday, August 6, 2026
TARS.summary: Tarsus Pharmaceuticals announced a webcast on August 6, 2026 to report Q2 2026 financial results and provide a corporate update. The company also announced an executive leadership transition with Chief Commercial Officer Aziz Mottiwala departing, while advancing its eye care strategy through the acquisition of iRenix Medical and the late-stage asset IRX-101 for ocular antiseptic use.

HIMS.title: HIMS & HERS HEALTH, INC. INVESTOR ALERT: Kirby McInerney LLP Announces Investigation Into Potential Securities Fraud
HIMS.summary: Law firm Kirby McInerney LLP is investigating Hims & Hers Health following an FTC lawsuit alleging the company engaged in deceptive privacy practices by sharing customers' sensitive medical information with third-party advertisers including Meta Platforms. The announcement triggered a 14.73% stock price decline on July 29, 2026.

JEF.title: JEF SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Jefferies Financial Group, Inc. Investors Encouraged to Contact Kirby McInerney LLP About Potential Securities Laws Violations
JEF.summary: Kirby McInerney LLP is investigating Jefferies Financial Group for potential securities law violations related to alleged misleading disclosures about the company's exposure to First Brands Group, a bankrupt auto-parts supplier, through its asset-management unit Point Bonita Capital. The SEC is reportedly investigating claims that Jefferies misled investors, with Point Bonita funds owed approximately $715 million from companies that purchased First Brands' parts. Jefferies disclosed a $30 million loss tied to First Brands' collapse, and the stock declined 9% on the news.

RDY.title: DR. REDDY’S LABORATORIES INVESTOR ALERT: Kirby McInerney LLP Announces Investigation Into Potential Securities Fraud
RDY.summary: Law firm Kirby McInerney LLP is investigating potential securities fraud claims against Dr. Reddy's Laboratories following the company's disclosure of a ₹2.4 billion provision for out-of-spec semaglutide batches in Q1 FY2027 earnings. The stock fell 9% on the news, though management stated there was no patient safety impact or regulatory filing impact.

LIF.title: How Families Can Stay Connected During Back-to-School Chaos
LIF.summary: A 2025 Life360 survey found that 83% of parents experience moderate-to-high back-to-school stress while spending 10 hours weekly managing schedules. Raddish Kids, a cooking subscription box for children ages 4-14+, positions itself as a solution to help families reconnect during the hectic school year by cooking meals together, building real-life skills, and creating meaningful family moments around the dinner table.

CRAUY.title: Built for Confidence: The Manufacturing Strength Behind FREELANDER 8
CRAUY.summary: FREELANDER, a British Premium Intelligent All-Terrain brand co-developed by Chery and Jaguar Land Rover, has begun mass production of the FREELANDER 8 at its Changshu Manufacturing Base in China. The facility, supported by over $3.1 billion in investment, features 1,100+ intelligent robots and advanced quality control systems. The vehicle is undergoing regional road testing in the Middle East ahead of its Abu Dhabi launch.

CRAUY.title: World-Renowned Explorer Ed Stafford Chooses the JETOUR G700
CRAUY.summary: JETOUR Auto has partnered with Discovery and explorer Ed Stafford to co-produce Season 2 of Adventure of Extremes. Stafford, the first person to hike the entire Amazon River, received a JETOUR G700 vehicle handover in Harbin. The G700 will serve as Stafford's mobile base camp during extreme expeditions across Ecuador, Colombia, and the Sahara Desert, showcasing the vehicle's off-road capability, intelligent technology, and V2L power export features.

HDSN.title: Hudson Technologies Re-Awarded Defense Logistics Agency Contract
HDSN.summary: Hudson Technologies (NASDAQ: HDSN) announced it has been re-awarded a $210 million Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract with the U.S. Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) following resolution of a bid protest. The initial five-year term runs through August 2031, with an optional five-year extension through 2036. The contract had been rescinded in January 2026 while a protest was evaluated, but the re-bid process has now been completed in Hudson's favor.

GIL.title: Gildan Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in Gildan Activewear Inc. (NYSE: GIL), You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
GIL.summary: The Rosen Law Firm is investigating potential securities claims against Gildan Activewear Inc. following a short seller report by Jehoshaphat Research that questioned the company's organic growth and sales practices. The report alleged that Gildan's organic growth has been negative for years despite appearing to show revenue growth through financial engineering. Gildan shares fell 18.7% on June 16, 2026, following the disclosure. The firm is preparing a class action lawsuit to recover investor losses.

GIL.title: GIL Legal News: Gildan Hit with Securities Fraud Investigation over Alleged Misrepresentations about its Revenue – Contact BFA Law
GIL.summary: Bleichmar Fonti & Auld LLP is investigating Gildan Activewear for potential securities fraud following allegations of channel stuffing to artificially inflate revenue. The investigation was triggered by a Jehoshaphat Research report published on June 16, 2026, which alleged the company manipulated sales figures. Gildan's stock dropped 18.75% ($11.62 per share) on the news. Investors who suffered losses are encouraged to contact BFA Law.

REPL.title: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. is Investigating Replimune Group Inc. on Behalf of Replimune Stockholders and Encourages Investors to Contact the Firm
REPL.summary: Law firm Bragar Eagel & Squire is investigating Replimune Group Inc. following FDA briefing documents that deemed the company's mid-stage study for its skin cancer drug RP1 as 'not interpretable.' The FDA assessment raised concerns about the study's ability to verify efficacy results. Following the news on July 28, 2026, Replimune's stock price dropped 37.89% in intraday trading.

TBLA.title: TBLA INVESTOR ALERT: Investigation of Taboola.com Ltd. Announced by Holzer & Holzer, LLC
TBLA.summary: Law firm Holzer & Holzer, LLC announced an investigation into Taboola.com Ltd. regarding potential federal securities law violations. On August 5, 2026, Taboola revised its fiscal year 2026 revenue guidance and reported Q2 2026 results that missed consensus estimates for both GAAP EPS and revenue, resulting in a stock price decline.

LGIH.title: LGI Homes, Inc. Reports July 2026 Home Closings
LGIH.summary: LGI Homes, Inc. (NASDAQ: LGIH) closed 427 homes in July 2026, representing a 12.1% year-over-year increase from 381 homes in July 2025. The company operates 152 active selling communities across 36 markets in 21 states. LGI Homes also announced strong Q2 2026 results and increased full-year guidance for average sales price and homebuilding gross margin, while expanding operations with a new community opening in North Dallas.

AUGO.title: Aura Declares Dividend of US$0.72 Per Share and US$0.24 Per BDR Based on Q2 2026 Results, Resulting in a Dividend Yield of 4.3% in the LTM
AUGO.summary: Aura Minerals Inc. announced a dividend of US$0.72 per common share (US$60.42 million total) and US$0.24 per BDR, exceeding its minimum dividend policy. The company reported record first-half 2026 production of 157,574 GEO (up 27% year-over-year) and H1 2026 Adjusted EBITDA of US$441 million (up 135% year-over-year). Additionally, the company announced a new share repurchase program of up to US$200 million.

EQNR.title: Transocean Ltd. Provides Quarterly Fleet Status Report
EQNR.summary: Transocean announced significant contract awards totaling approximately $292 million in firm fixtures across multiple rigs in the U.S. Gulf, Norway, Ivory Coast, and Australia. Additionally, the company secured a conditional agreement with Equinor valued at approximately $1.0 billion for three harsh environment semisubmersible rigs on the Norwegian shelf. As of August 5, 2026, Transocean's total backlog reached approximately $6.7 billion, excluding the Equinor backlog pending license partner approvals.

RIG.title: Transocean Ltd. Provides Quarterly Fleet Status Report

ETD.title: Ethan Allen Confirms Receipt of Director Nominations from Doug Bergeron

The Board's Corporate Governance, Nominations and Sustainability Committee will review the nominees and present recommendations in the definitive proxy statement to be filed with the SEC.

BIOA.title: BioAge Labs Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Updates
BIOA.summary: BioAge Labs announced the first participant dosing in QUELL-CV, a Phase 2 trial of BGE-102, an oral NLRP3 inhibitor for patients with obesity and elevated inflammation. Phase 1 data showed BGE-102 achieved up to 98% suppression of IL-1β and 86% median hsCRP reductions. The company also plans to initiate QUELL-DME trial in diabetic macular edema in mid-2026. BioAge reported Q2 2026 net loss of $26.1 million with $381.3 million in cash, sufficient to fund operations through 2029.

LXFR.title: Halper Sadeh LLC is Investigating Whether FBRX, LXFR, SMTI, MKTX are Obtaining Fair Deals for their Shareholders

WBD.title: Game of Thrones™ Goes Live with BetMGM in Alberta, Building on Record-Setting Ontario Debut

WBD.title: French Retail Giant Carrefour to Reveal Brand Extension Strategies in Exclusive Keynote Panel at Brand Licensing Europe

Warner Bros. Discovery will also present a keynote on 25 years of Harry Potter movies. The event features over 2,500 brands and 7,500+ industry professionals.

INTU.summary: A securities fraud class action lawsuit has been filed against Intuit Inc. (NASDAQ: INTU) for allegedly making materially false statements about its tax business strength and competitive advantages. The lawsuit covers the period from August 22, 2025 through May 20, 2026. DLTH.title: Best Clothing for Hot Weather: Duluth Trading Shares Cooling Apparel, UPF Clothing and Summer Workwear
DLTH.summary: Duluth Trading Co. launched new collections of cooling apparel and UPF-rated clothing designed to help consumers stay comfortable during extreme heat and unpredictable weather. The company highlighted its Armachillo® line featuring jade-infused cooling technology and Dry on the Fly® quick-drying apparel, addressing increased consumer demand for functional summer workwear as record-breaking temperatures grip the United States.

SCYT.title: Security Bancorp, Inc. Announces Second Quarter Earnings
SCYT.summary: Security Bancorp, Inc. reported Q2 2026 net income of $1.6 million ($4.31 per share), up 33% from $1.2 million ($3.30 per share) in Q2 2025. Net interest income increased 21.1% to $3.9 million, driven by loan growth and higher interest rates. Total assets grew to $386.1 million with loans increasing $11.2 million. The company's equity ratio improved to 11.6% of total assets.

AB.title: Crypto News: Pepeto Announces Investment Growth While Bitcoin Price Targets $250K
AB.summary: Bitcoin has recovered to ~$70k after a 50% decline from October 2025 peaks, sparking debate among analysts. BX.summary: Wolf Popper LLP filed a securities class action lawsuit against Smartsheet Inc. on behalf of shareholders who sold stock between June 1 and September 23, 2024. GWBK.title: Gateway Bank, F.S.B. Strengthens Construction Lending Team with Two New Additions, Names Tom Rodriguez EVP, Construction Manager
GWBK.summary: Gateway Bank, F.S.B. announced the hiring of Tom Rodriguez as Executive Vice President, Construction Manager, and Twana Sonesing as Associate Vice President, Construction Underwriter to strengthen its construction lending operations. IPW.summary: iPower Inc. (Nasdaq: IPW) announced a 1-for-9 reverse stock split effective August 7, 2026, reducing outstanding shares from approximately 7.03 million to 781,068. The company is simultaneously pivoting toward AI infrastructure investments and GPU deployment opportunities.

TGT.title: 2026 Holiday Shopping Will Be Driven by AI-Powered Discovery, According to Optimove Insights Report
TGT.summary: A new Holiday Shopping Report 2026 reveals that AI tools are now integral to holiday shopping, with 72% of consumers using ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini for product discovery and gift recommendations. Despite strong trust in AI recommendations, data privacy concerns remain a barrier. The report also shows strong holiday spending intent, with 55% planning to spend more than last year, though consumers still favor familiar brands and major retailers like Amazon (81%), Walmart (71%), and Target (58%).

The company now operates 42 locations across Texas and is part of Integrity Care Group, backed by Goldman Sachs Sustainable Investment Fund.

SGPIY.summary: SERES Group, marking its 40th anniversary, discussed its ESG strategy and sustainability goals in an exclusive interview. AIFF.title: Firefly Neuroscience (NASDAQ: AIFF) Reports 291% Increase in TMS Center Customer Brain Scan Volumes
AIFF.summary: Firefly Neuroscience announced a nearly four-fold increase in TMS center customer clinical assessments using its FDA-cleared Evoke AI-powered EEG/ERP platform. The platform combines quantitative EEG and event-related potentials to help clinicians assess brain activity and tailor treatments for psychiatric and behavioral health conditions. The company continues to expand adoption among TMS centers while building its proprietary database of over 200,000 EEG/ERP brain scans.

GNENY.title: Lithium Argentina Announces $220 Million of New Debt Facilities Closed at Cauchari-Olaroz
GNENY.summary: Lithium Argentina announced the closure of $220 million in new unsecured debt facilities for its Cauchari-Olaroz lithium brine operation. The financing consists of a $50 million two-year facility and a $170 million three-year facility with an interest rate under 5%, supported by a guarantee from partner Ganfeng Lithium. The funds will strengthen the company's balance sheet and support Stage 2 expansion plans to increase production capacity by 45,000 tonnes per annum of lithium carbonate equivalent.

Elliott and CFO Claire K. Spencer at 4:00 p.m. Central Time.

ETON.title: Eton Pharmaceuticals Expands Infantile Hemangioma Franchise with Acquisition of U.S. Rights to Late-Stage Product Candidate ASN-001
ETON.summary: Eton Pharmaceuticals has licensed U.S. rights to ASN-001 (timolol topical gel) from Auson Pharmaceuticals for treating moderate infantile hemangiomas. Phase II/III trial results showed 56% elimination rates at week 24 with twice-daily dosing versus 15% for placebo. The company plans to submit an NDA in H2 2027 with potential approval and launch in 2028, targeting an estimated 20,000-30,000 patients annually and positioning ASN-001 as a complementary product to its existing HEMANGEOL therapy.

ABX.title: Court Unseals Key Evidence in Coventry Filing Showing Abacus Global Management Relied on Short Lapetus Life Expectancy Estimates and Misled Investors
ABX.summary: A U.S. District Court unsealed documents in litigation between Coventry and Abacus Global Management revealing that Abacus knowingly relied on significantly underestimated life expectancy data from Lapetus Solutions and misled investors about a Lewis & Ellis valuation report. Lapetus showed a 41.5% actual-to-expected mortality ratio compared to industry standards near 100%, and Abacus allegedly manipulated the Lewis & Ellis report by using different discount rates and withholding life expectancy estimates to inflate portfolio valuations.

RYTM.summary: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals announced preliminary Phase 2 trial results for RM-718, an investigational MC4R agonist, showing an 11.6% mean BMI reduction in acquired hypothalamic obesity patients at 16 weeks.
